description: Jeff has worked in the real estate business for a better part of his life and loves working with people to solve one of the most important financial decisions a person can make. His company, Jeff Dotseth & Associates Realty Incorporated, offers would-be home and property owners a variety of special services. He has been in the real estate and construction business for over 20 years too. Jeff has extensive experience in residential real estate, including commercial and unique properties - together with expertise in land sales and purchases he has become known as the "go to man" for anything real estate.
